projects.title: SuperSort
projects.goal: Search for genuinely new, architecture-aware mechanisms that make practically relevant sorting tasks substantially faster than the best existing implementations.

latest.title: Page-remapped merge candidate
latest.summary: Mapping aligned input pages into the output beat the best fresh-output merge of two sorted runs of 128-byte records by 1.33–1.36×, and by 2.67× when 75% of the output was mapped. It lost to a merge into an already-touched buffer (0.36–0.74×) and regressed on bursty and interleaved runs (0.82–0.86×). Synthetic data only.
latest.result: 1.326–2.668× on edge-overlap runs (2/4 cases ≥1.3×, 0/4 ≥1.5× on both seeds)
